title: Check: Comparing Aerobic and Anaerobic Respiration (Part 2) (C)

questions.stem: Which is a disadvantage of anaerobic respiration in animals?

options.text: It cannot occur in muscle cells
It produces lactic acid which causes muscle fatigue
It takes too long to release energy

questions.explanation: A key disadvantage of anaerobic respiration in animals is the build-up of lactic acid, which lowers pH in muscles, causes pain, and leads to fatigue, reducing the ability to continue exercising.
